rationale: John brings deep cloud infrastructure and AI/ML ops expertise (AWS, GCP, Azure) paired with a conviction that agentic AI and cloud-native systems are enterprise AI's foundation, while Ming is architecting verifiable compute primitives (zkVM, Ziren) for decentralized AI and autonomous systems. Their complementary technical depth—John in operational infrastructure, Ming in cryptographic proofs and universal computation—could spark ideas around how to build trustless, verifiable AI agents at scale, especially as agentic systems move toward production deployment.
intro_message: John Komarnicki, meet Ming Guo — John's expertise in cloud-native AI infrastructure and operational leadership could complement Ming's work on verifiable compute for autonomous systems, particularly as agentic AI moves from concept to enterprise production.
